about.title: About Heart Rate Calculator - Training Zone Optimizer
about.description: The Heart Rate Calculator determines your target heart rate zones for different exercise intensities based on your age and fitness level. Understanding your heart rate zones helps optimize workout effectiveness and ensures safe exercise intensity. Target heart rate zones are essential for cardiovascular training, fat burning, and improving overall fitness. The calculator uses established formulas to provide personalized heart rate ranges for various training goals.

faq.q: What is target heart rate and why is it important?
faq.a: Target heart rate is the ideal heart rate range during exercise to achieve specific fitness goals. It's typically expressed as a percentage of your maximum heart rate and helps ensure you're training at the right intensity for optimal results and safety.

faq.q: How do I accurately measure my resting heart rate?
faq.a: Measure your pulse for 60 seconds immediately after waking up, before getting out of bed or consuming caffeine. Take measurements for several consecutive days and use the average. Normal resting heart rate ranges from 60-100 BPM for adults.

faq.q: What's the fat burning zone and how effective is it?
faq.a: The fat burning zone is typically 60-70% of maximum heart rate, where your body primarily uses fat for energy. While this zone uses a higher percentage of fat for fuel, higher intensities burn more total calories and can be more effective for weight loss.

faq.q: Is it safe to exercise at maximum heart rate?
faq.a: Exercising at maximum heart rate should only be done by well-trained athletes for short periods during interval training. Most people should stay within 50-85% of maximum heart rate for safe and effective exercise. Consult healthcare providers before high-intensity training.
